context:
DECISION GATE w1: choose ONE of (a) route run mode through the same run-service path 'benchbox run' uses, so data generation, adapter config, and phase handling are shared; or (b) delete run mode entirely and make -p/--platform exit 2 with a message pointing at 'benchbox run' + file mode. Record the choice and the reason before writing code. Prefer (a) only if it reuses run_service rather than growing a second runner; choose (b) if (a) cannot be done without duplicating the runner.

Whichever is chosen, correctness of the FAILURE path is mandatory and independent: a platform that raises must not be reported as 100% success, must not contribute to fastest/slowest or speedup, and the command must exit non-zero when any requested platform produced zero queries.
description:
VERIFIED on develop 2026-08-23. The invocation printed as the FIRST example in 'benchbox compare --help' does not work:

  $ uv run -- benchbox compare -p duckdb -p sqlite --scale 0.01 --non-interactive
  Failed to benchmark duckdb: 'benchmark'
  Failed to benchmark sqlite: SQLite requires database path configuration.
  Total Queries: 0 / Fastest: duckdb / Speedup: 1.00x
  duckdb N/A N/A 100%   sqlite N/A N/A 100%
  EXIT=0

Mechanism: benchbox/core/comparison/suite.py:190-224 (_benchmark_sql_platform) is a hardcoded TPC-H-only path. It never calls the real benchmark runner, never generates data, and for duckdb/sqlite/datafusion guesses a data directory 'benchmark_runs/tpch/sf<X>/data' that a new user does not have. duckdb dies with KeyError 'benchmark' from get_adapter() on an empty config; sqlite raises ConfigurationError at sqlite.py:209-211 before the directory check is even reached. Both exceptions are swallowed at suite.py:157-171, which appends a result that BYPASSES _build_platform_result, so the dataclass default success_rate=100.0 (benchbox/core/comparison/types.py:210) survives into the printed table.

Customer impact: a user comparing two engines is told the run succeeded at 100% with a 1.00x speedup when zero queries executed, and CI wrappers see exit 0. Reporting a fabricated success is worse than crashing.

Scope note: FILE mode ('benchbox compare a.json b.json') WORKS and is not in scope. Only run mode (-p/--platform) is broken. Independently confirmed by two adversarial reviewers on 2026-08-23.

RESOLVED 2026-08-23 in PR #1836 (branch fix/compare-run-mode-false-success). make pr-preflight green: 28,018 passed, 0 failed. Awaiting review/merge.

anti_patterns.dont: Add a second benchmark runner inside benchbox/core/comparison/
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD reuse the run-service path or delete run mode
anti_patterns.why: that is exactly how the current dead code path came to exist and it will drift from run_service the same way

anti_patterns.dont: Fix the symptom by hiding the summary table when query_count is 0
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD fix the exit code and the success_rate computation
anti_patterns.why: the command would still exit 0 and still claim to have compared engines

anti_patterns.dont: Mark this done because file mode works
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD verify the exact help-text example
anti_patterns.why: the broken invocation is the one the CLI prints as its own first example

preserves.behavior: Existing exit-code contract for file-mode regression gating in CI
File mode (benchbox compare a.json b.json) keeps working unchanged, including --fail-on-regression and --include-plans

prior_art.concept: working single-platform run path that already handles datagen, adapter config and phases

verifications.command: uv run -- benchbox compare -p duckdb -p sqlite --scale 0.01 --non-interactive; echo EXIT=$?
verifications.description: The help text's own first example produces a real comparison or a non-zero exit
verifications.expected: per-query table with Total Queries > 0, or EXIT != 0. Never Total Queries 0 with 100% and 1.00x

verifications.command: uv run -- benchbox compare -p duckdb -p snowflake --scale 0.01 --non-interactive
verifications.description: A failing platform is never reported as successful
verifications.expected: snowflake reported as failed with 0% success; EXIT != 0

verifications.command: uv run -- benchbox compare benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf1_duckdb_sql_20260724_083841_f0d8a264.json benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf1_datafusion_sql_20260724_083804_6f70346c.json; echo EXIT=$?

work_units.evidence: Reproduced on develop f7e98858: compare -p duckdb -p sqlite --scale 0.01 printed Total Queries 0, Fastest duckdb, Speedup 1.00x, both platforms 100%, EXIT=0
work_units.summary: Reproduce on a clean checkout and capture the exact stdout plus exit code as evidence

work_units.evidence: DECISION: option (a) - route through BenchmarkOrchestrator.execute_benchmark, the entry benchbox run uses. Chosen because it reuses the existing resolved-input path rather than growing a second runner; option (b) (delete run mode) rejected since the fix reuses existing code and keeps the documented feature. Constraint discovered during implementation: benchbox.core may not import benchbox.cli (import-linter 'utils < core < platforms < cli'), so the suite takes an injected platform_runner and the CLI supplies the wiring - same shape as execute_run(adapter_factory=...).
work_units.summary: DECISION GATE - choose (a) reuse run_service or (b) remove run mode; record the decision and reason in the item before any code change

work_units.evidence: success_rate default 100.0->0.0 in types.py; SQL failure path now builds through _build_platform_result; get_summary returns None fastest/slowest/speedup when nothing timed; ALL sentinel excluded from total_queries; CLI _exit_on_comparison_failure exits 1. Verified: duckdb+snowflake -> snowflake 0%, no ratio, EXIT=1

_benchmark_sql_platform delegates to the injected runner; superseded in-suite TPC-H runner and _setup_embedded_sql removed (106 lines). Verified: compare -p duckdb -p sqlite --scale 0.01 -> 22 queries each, geomean 1.82 vs 13.47ms, 7.40x, EXIT=0
work_units.summary: Implement the chosen option from w1

work_units.evidence: tests/unit/cli/test_compare_run_mode_exit_contract.py (11 tests) pins the help-text example contract: failed platform never 100%, no fabricated ranking, ALL sentinel not counted, single survivor has no speedup, exit codes. Two tests that pinned the defect updated.
work_units.summary: Add a regression test that executes the exact example printed by 'benchbox compare --help' and asserts a real per-query table or a non-zero exit - never a 100%/1.00x table with zero queries

work_units.evidence: Help text examples verified against shipped behaviour; the first --help example now runs. No doc text changes needed - the examples were correct, the code was not.
work_units.summary: Reconcile the help text and docs with the shipped behaviour so no advertised example is broken
